rationale: No Synthetics tests or page objects exist in the codebase. This is a brand-new feature area — the first Synthetics E2E spec. The spec must be registered in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json as a new shard entry (testfolder: 'Synthetics', actual_folder: 'Synthetics') and a new Synthetics page object (`syntheticsPage.js`) must be created in tests/ui-testing/pages/.
